item.title: The OnePlus 15T is looking more and more impressive
item.description: The forthcoming OnePlus 15T is looking less and less like a compromised ‘almost-flagship’, and more like a compact power house. We learned last week that the OnePlus 15T was officially “Coming Soon”, though we’re sceptical of its chances of a wider release. That’s a shame, because it’s shaping up to be a spectacular phone. item.description: Amidst constant talk of smartphones getting more expensive, the OnePlus 16 has been tipped for a huge price hike. item.description: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms season 1 finale brought some peace after the intense trial by combat episode. item.title: The 10 best tablets our experts recommend
item.description: In 2026, the tablet has carved out an important niche, and unlike many phones, the latest models are bringing significant upgrades. While dreams of it as a laptop replacement haven’t materialised for most people, they can still operate as a highly competent productivity device, with the most powerful slates offering plenty of power for desktop-grade apps. item.title: Lanterns first trailer teases a small-town murder mystery
item.description: After appearing as a side character in several TV series and a 2011 standalone (yet disastrous) movie, Green Lantern will get a new chance to shine. A superhero crime series called Lanterns is heading to HBO Max as part of the rebooted DC film universe – and the first trailer is already out. The showrunner for Lanterns is Chris Mundy, Emmy nominee for Ozark and co-executive producer of True Detective season 4. item.title: The OnePlus 15T is getting a “massive battery”
item.description: The OnePlus 15T has been confirmed to feature a ginormous battery, dwarfing that of its big brother and plenty of rivals to boot. It’ll also get even faster charging. It has been widely speculated that while the follow-up to the OnePlus 15 will be a smaller phone, it’ll pack an even larger battery. item.title: The Suri 2.0 is out in a new, spring-ready colour
item.description: Of all the electric toothbrushes I tested last year, the Suri 2.0 was my favourite. Not every electric toothbrush is particularly enjoyable to use, but this one is. It’s light, quiet, it feels pleasant in the hand, its battery life is impressive – so you won’t always be hunting around for a charger – and its design is elegant.
